newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 9.371 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 9.371 bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned six-month maturity short-term federal bonds worth 9.371 billion rupees on Tuesday at a weighted average yield of 16.39686 percent per annum.
The bank recieved bids worth a total of 12.570 billion rupees out of which bids for 9.371 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on May 19, bids worth 5.633 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 17.42086 percent per annum.
